title: : DO NOT THROW AWAY YOUR CONFIDENCE
verse: “And then GOD answered: "Write this. Write what
body: : DO NOT THROW AWAY YOUR CONFIDENCE “And then GOD answered: "Write this. Write what you see. Write it out in big block letters so that it can be read on the run.” (TBCL) Hab 2:2-3. In a profound statement, Helen Keller, who was born blind was once asked, “What would be worse than being born blind?” She replied “Having sight without a vision.” Vision is the bridge between the present and the future; the lens that interprets the events of life. In a simplified term, it’s a dream with a deadline. With a clear-cut vision, vigorous pursuit and unbroken focus, actualisation is inevitable. And so, you ought to have your clear cut vision written down for proper execution and monitoring. Besides, to be ahead, walk with those who are ahead. Sir Isaac Newton, (1642-1727), one of the foremost scientific intellects said, “If I have seen farther than others, it is because I was standing on the shoulders of giants.” No man figures it out perfectly all alone. You’ve to stand on the shoulders of the fathers - real, true fathers - to go farther. Woodrow Wilson said, “You are not here merely to make a living. You are here in order to enable the world to live more amply, with greater vision.”
confession: I am set for great achievements.

title: : YOU NEED A CLEAR CUT VISION
body: : YOU NEED A CLEAR CUT VISION “Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession” (KJV) Psalm 2:8 In a striking and eye-catching style, Jesus straightly commanded us in Luke 10:2, “. The harvest indeed is abundant [there is much ripe grain], but the farmhands are few. Pray therefore the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into His harvest” (Amp). As labourers are needed, so intercessors are desperately needed. The act of interceding is a must for all true Christians. Agree with God - to intercede for the lost every blessed day. Pray for more labourers. Loose the grip of sin over sinners. You can move the hand that moves the world. You can touch the world through prayers. You can effect changes in the spiritual realm on your knees. You can plant eternity in the hearts of men via the act of prevailing prayers, Jam 5:16. Prayer has no limit! Prayer uttered in Africa can take effect in Australia. That’s the intercontinentality of prayer.
prayer: I ask of thee O LORD, the heathen for my inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for my possession. I release young and old from demonic stronghold of sin in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : ON YOUR KNEES - FOR THE LOST
body: : ON YOUR KNEES - FOR THE LOST “In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men.” (KJV) Job 33:15 Searching through the Bible, there are numerous instances of dreams. In a dream, God warned Abimelech (Gen 20:3); God spoke to Jacob (Gen 46:2-4). Read Gen 37:5-10 and Dan 2:14-45. God gave the ability to interpret dreams to Joseph (Gen 40:8; 41:12) and Daniel (Dan 2:20-45). As we come to the New Testament, God gave a dream to Joseph concerning Mary’s innocence (Matt 1:20-21). God appeared to Joseph in a dream after Jesus’ birth (Matt 1:20). As dreams could come from God, so dreams could also come from satan, 2 Cor 11:14. Besides, dreams could come through the activities of the day, Eccl 5:3. Ultimately, God is ever present to guide you through so as to understand the purpose of every dream and pray aright. Above it all, take advantage of the potency of prayer to combat every negative dream - 2 Cor 10:4-5.
confession: When I lie down, I will not be afraid. Yes, my sleep will be sweet. In peace, I will both lie down and sleep; for You alone, O Lord, make me dwell in safety. And so, the sun shall not smite me by day, nor the moon by night.

title: : DREAMS OF THE NIGHT
body: : DREAMS OF THE NIGHT

title: : THE SPIRIT OF EXCELLENCE
body: : THE SPIRIT OF EXCELLENCE “. God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom.” (KJV) Dan 1:17 God, in His categorical statement said, “If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him” (KJV) Jam 1:5. You can stand out. Just as Daniel was found ten times better, so you can experience such spirit of exceeding excellence. “But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal. For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit. But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will” (KJV) 1 Cor 12:7-11. Here is earnest prayer of Paul, Eph1:17, “That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him” (KJV). This is prophetic: “And the Spirit of the Lord shall rest upon [me] - the Spirit of wisdom and understanding. “ Isa 11:2-3.
prayer: I receive the spirit of understanding, the Spirit of counsel and might. I receive the spirit of excellence. I am excelling in all my undertakings in the name that is above other names, Amen. “The LORD asked me, "Jeremiah, what do you see.” (TEV) Jeremiah 1:11 “Only he who can see the invisible can do the impossible.” said Frank Gaines. Life does not give more than you bargain for - bargain for a penny, then you’ve just a penny; bargain for plenty and so, you’ve exactly what you bargain for. “It's not what you look at that matters, it's what you see” said Henry David Thoreau. Vision affects you and everything about you. Once you’ve got the visions for your life, you’ve to simplify them by breaking them down into a yearly, quarterly, monthly, weekly and daily goals. James Allen said, “Dream lofty dreams, and as you dream, so shall you become. Your Vision is the promise of what you shall one day be. Your Ideal is the prophecy of what you shall at last unveil.” William Jennings Bryan said, “Destiny is not a matter of chance, but of choice. Not something to wish for, but to attain.” “It is a terrible thing to see and have no vision” said Helen Keller.

title: : THE POWER OF VISION
body: : THE POWER OF VISION

title: : A NOT ABLE MAN OF VISION
verse: “. the hand of the diligent.” (KJV) Pro 10:4
body: : A NOT ABLE MAN OF VISION “. the hand of the diligent.” (KJV) Pro 10:4 “In all labour” says the Bible, “there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury” (KJV) Pro 14:23. You can’t be a mere talker and be a ‘topper.’ It takes work to rise and shine. Asa Griggs Candler was the owner of the company that is world-famous till date - Coca-Cola. Born in Carroll County in 1851. In 1888 his life took a turn when he bought the Coca-Cola Company and spent the next ten years trying to turn it into a global giant with heavy and strategic marketing - he used innovative advertising and distribution methods. If you must rise, you must give it all it takes to succeed. You must be a strategic thinker! An excellent innovator! As Candler made his multimillions, he then diversified by investing in real estate and banking. Asa Candler's great wealth enabled him to make large several donations. How you must be a donator to kingdom projects and worthwhile visions! 2 Cor 9:7.
confession: I refuse to be limited. I am going forward in strategic thinking and excellent innovation. I’ll not give up till I see God’s purpose fulfilled for my life. By the reason of Your help, I’m getting there and nothing shall hinder me. “And the LORD God. put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it” (KJV) Gen 2:15 On 7th January 1922, Henry Ford wrote: “The gifted man bears his gifts into the world, not for his own benefit, but for the people among whom he is placed; for the gifts are not his, he himself is a gift to the community.” He wrote on 6th June 1913, “I will build a motor car for the great multitude. so low in price that no man making a good salary will be unable to own one-and enjoy with his family the blessing of hours of pleasure in God's great open spaces.” Henry Ford became an icon of a selfmade man and became rich and famous for life. At age 17, Henry Ford left the farm to Detroit to become an apprentice. After the Quadricycle, Henry started working on making automobiles for sale. On July 15, 1903, the Ford Motor Company sold its first car. Between 1908 and 1927, Ford produced the Model T to appeal to the masses, building 15 million cars. In spites of the challenges, Ford made a way where there was no way. Ford continually worked to improve the cars' design and soon created Models B, C, and F.

title: : A PASSIONA TE MAN OF VISION
body: : A PASSIONA TE MAN OF VISION “. the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not.” (KJV) Gen 15:1 John D. Rockefeller (1839-1937) said, “If you want to succeed you should strike out on new paths, rather than travel the worn paths of accepted success.” Speaking on the need for resolute determination, “I do not think that there is any other quality so essential to success of any kind as the quality of perseverance. It overcomes almost everything, even nature.” “I believe in the dignity of labor, whether with head or hand; that the world owes no man a living but that it owes every man an opportunity to make a living.” “Don't be afraid to give up the good to go for the great.” He was one of the world’s wealthiest men and philanthropist. In 1870, he established Standard Oil, which by the early 1880s controlled some 90 percent of U. S. refineries and pipelines. Rockefeller donated more than half a billion dollars to various educational, religious and scientific causes. Consciously cultivate a giving lifestyle and experience the joy of giving.
prayer: Father, thank You for Your depth of inspiration. I ask that Your ever-abiding presence keep guiding me aright in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : A DYNAMIC MAN OF VISION
verse: “. according to the time of life.” (KJV) Gen 18:10
body: : A DYNAMIC MAN OF VISION “. according to the time of life.” (KJV) Gen 18:10 Eccl 3:11 says, “He has set the right time for everything. He has given us a desire to know the future, but never gives us the satisfaction of fully understanding what he does” (GNT). God determines the time - for the fulfilment and manifestation of every vision. CEV says, “God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.” If it is God’s vision, you have to wait for God’s timing. Every Godordained vision goes through God-ordained test before God-ordained triumph. God’s purpose for Sarah came to pass according to the time of life. “Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son” (KJV) Gen 18:14. What a promise! I have a word for you today: that which you are trusting God for shall come to see the light of the day - you will not miss it, Gen 21:2. Here comes a prayer focus, Ps 90:14.
confession: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion [Put your name]: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come [Say this severally].

title: : UNDERST ANDING DIVINE TIMING
body: : UNDERST ANDING DIVINE TIMING

title: : NEGA TING NEGA TIVE DREAMS
verse: “A dream which made me afraid.” (KJV) Dan 4:5
body: : NEGA TING NEGA TIVE DREAMS “A dream which made me afraid.” (KJV) Dan 4:5 Dreams, no matter how negative - terrifying, scary and dreadful - they might appear to be, can be invalidated, reversed and rendered null and void. Negative dreams are no final. Isa 54:17 says, “But no weapon that can hurt you has ever been forged. Any accuser who takes you to court will be dismissed as a liar. This is what GOD's servants can expect. I'll see to it that everything works out for the best. GOD's Decree” (TBCL). No evil plan is permitted to succeed in your life. There is a divine coverage over your life 24/7. “Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries.” (KJV) Isa 8:9-10. When you wake up to discover the dream you had was contrary, you don’t have to be troubled. Simply switch on to the faith-line and declare the Word. The Word of God supersedes that negative dream. The Word prevails and triumphs - Jam 5:16.
confession: [I] will be established in righteousness. [I] will be far from oppression, so [I] will not be afraid. [I] will be far from destruction, so it won't come near [me]. “. Write down all these instructions, for they represent the terms of the covenant.” (NLT) Exo 34:27 Apostle Peter writing by the Spirit of God, “This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance” (KJV) 2 Pet 3:1. Writing down your vision is strategic to your success. Have a written vision for your spiritual, material, financial, family, business, ministerial and academic life. Write the ways by which these visions could be achieved. Destiny, you must understand, is never a game of chance; it’s a game of taking a full responsibility. Get the visions properly documented and don't forget to pray over them daily. Most of all, do bear in mind that you need God all the way. “Unless the LORD builds a house, its builders labor over it in vain; unless the LORD watches over a city, the watchman stays alert in vain” (HCSB) Ps 127:1. As you walk with Him and work for Him; He walks with you and works for you, 1 Sam 2:9. Make Him your friend - your companion and confidant - and He will be there when it seems dark and dreary.

title: : WRITE THE VISION
body: : WRITE THE VISION

title: : GOD SPEAKS THROUGH VISIONS
body: : GOD SPEAKS THROUGH VISIONS “And God speaketh to Israel in visions of the night, and saith, 'Jacob.’” (YLT) Gen 46:2 In an emphatic statement, “The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our sons forever, that we may observe all the words of this law” (NASB) Deut 29:29. He is the Revealer of all things. He makes known what is concealed, exposes the hidden things and discloses the intentions of men. “The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant” (KJV) Ps 25:14. “Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven. The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret” (KJV) Dan 2:19, 22, 23, 47. Are you in doubt about any aspect of your life? Are you in dark as to which step to take? You can take the matter to the Revealer of all things - Mark 4:22 and Amos 3:7.
confession: Nothing shall be hidden from me, dear LORD GOD, I shall always ride on the wings of visions and revelations - always knowing what to do per time. “. in a humble (gentle, modest) spirit receive and welcome the Word which implanted and rooted [in your hearts].” (AMP) Jam 1:21 Heb 1:1-3 says, “God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets, Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds” (KJV). In all matters of life, the Bible is the ultimate. God leads as He chooses. And remember, God does not contradict Himself neither is He the author of confusion. If any dream, vision or revelation opposes the written Word of God, that dream, vision or revelation is not of God nor from God, 1 Cor 14:33. The closer you are to God, the simpler it becomes to understand His will. “The steps of good men are directed by the Lord. He delights in each step they take. If they fall it isn't fatal, for the Lord holds them with his hand” (TLB) Ps 37:23-24. The Holy Spirit is there both to lead and guide - John 16:13-14.

title: : THE BIBLE, THE UL TIMA TE
body: : THE BIBLE, THE UL TIMA TE

title: : EXPERIENCING GOD’S GLOR Y
verse: all flesh shall see it together.” (KJV) Isa 40:5
body: : EXPERIENCING GOD’S GLOR Y “And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together.” (KJV) Isa 40:5 With a prophetic tone, Zechariah declared, “For I, saith the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her” (KJV) 2:5. God’s unchanging decree and immutable verdict is that He will be the wall of fire round about you. God meant what He says and says what He meant. “Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations” (KJV) Deut 7:9. God’s Word is predictable. When you keep to your part, He keeps to His part of covenant. Experiencing a higher dimension of His glory must be our passionate prayer. Moses prayed, “. I beseech thee, shew me thy glory” (KJV) Exo 33:18. Despite the experience Moses had with God on the mount [Exo 33:11], he cried for yet another dimension of God’ unfading glory.
prayer: Dear Lord God, I love to experience Y-OU in a new dimension. Cause me to partake of the vision of Your G-L-O-R-Y. For this I pray in Jesus precious name, Amen. “And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more.” (KJV) Gen 37:9 How true was Sarah Ban Breathnach when She said, “The world needs dreamers and the world needs doers. But above all, the world needs dreamers who do.” Dreams alone are not enough; every dream must be accompanied with doing, for without it dreams are mere flight of fancy - it goes no where. Purpose belongs to God but plans belong to man. “Cherish your visions and your dreams as they are the children of your soul, the blueprints of your ultimate achievements” said Napoleon Hill. Don’t be like prophet Ezekiel who was not sure the dry bones could live again. “. And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest” (KJV) Eze 37:1-3. Except you act, no one acts for you. You are the only you who can do what only you is destined to do. Reach forth, You’re made a high flier.

title: : THE WORLD NEEDS DREAMERS
body: : THE WORLD NEEDS DREAMERS

title: : TRY EVER Y SPIRIT
verse: whether they are of God.” (NIV) 1 John 4:1
body: : TRY EVER Y SPIRIT “Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God.” (NIV) 1 John 4:1 Dokimazo, that is the Greek for the word ‘try’ meaning ‘test’, ‘examine’ or ‘scrutinize’ in order to prove the genuineness of a word or thing. This is what we are commanded to do, so as not to fall into error and miss the way. Apostle Paul, in his first epistle to the Thessalonians chapter 5 verse 21, said with all apostolic authority and audacity, “Prove all things; hold fast that which is good” (NWB). Jesus warns us: “. Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many” (KJV) Matt 24:4-5. “As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him” (KJV) Ps 18:30. Get married to the Word. Read it - everyday - to be well acquainted. Relate with the Word. Interact with the Word and let the Word become your close associate. By so doing, you’ll always be kept above the spirit of error and heresy of our days - 1 John 2:18.
prayer: Thank You for Your Word and the inspiration from Your throne. Dear Father, I ask that You help me to always be sensitive to Your Spirit leading in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen. “Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets” (KJV) Amos 3:7 God never dealt with the Israelites as He did to other Nations of the world: He gave them special treat - He revealed His secrets - not keeping them in the dark. The Israelites were in strict correspondence with God, and He showed them things to come. It’s God’s intention to make known His intent to you. “And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do” (KJV) Gen 18:17. “Deep calleth unto deep.” (KJV) Ps 42:7. Your depth of revelation depends on the depth of relationship you have with God. “Godfriendship is for God-worshipers; They are the ones he confides in” (TBCL) Ps 25:14. “The secret [of the sweet, satisfying companionship] of the Lord have they who fear (revere and worship) Him, and He will show them His covenant and reveal to them its [deep, inner] meaning” (AMP). He doesn’t reveal His secrets to every dick, tom and harry. He reveals His secrets to His true friends - John 15:15.

title: : HE REVEALS HIS SECRET
body: : HE REVEALS HIS SECRET

title: : OUTPOURING OF GOD’S SPIRIT
body: : OUTPOURING OF GOD’S SPIRIT “And it shall come to pass in the last days, God declares, that I will pour out of My Spirit upon all mankind.” (AMP) Acts 2:17 “All over the world the Spirit is moving, All over the world as the Prophet said it should be, All over the world there is a mighty revelation.” It’s the earnest desire of the Almighty God that all His children experience His mightiness via the act and demonstration of the Holy Spirit, Acts 2:18. As we release ourselves, He fills us with His Spirit and might. “For I will pour water upon him who is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground. I will pour My Spirit upon your offspring.” (Amp) Isa 44:3. If you must partake in the outpouring, thirst for it, seek it with all your heart and tarry for it until you’re endued with power from on high. Pray until you’re wet and soaked in the latter rain. “He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water” (WEB) John 7:38-39.
confession: The Spirit of God is resident in me. “But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.” [Pray with Special Breakthrough Prayers] “. King Agrippa, I did not prove disobedient to the heavenly vision” (NASB) Acts 26:19 Every man is bought with a price. Every Christian has a price tag on his life. We are not of ourselves - we belong to God by creation and redemption - our lives must be lived for Him and His vision. God has a vision and it’s a global vision of world-wide harvest of souls. He wants all men saved irrespective of their social, educational, geographical and ethnic background. Matt 24:14 says, “And this Good News of the Kingdom shall be proclaimed throughout the whole world to set the evidence before all the Gentiles; and then the End will come ” (WNT). “You may say that there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest” (CEV) John 4:35. “I have but one passion: It is He, it is He alone. The world is the field and the field is the world” said Count Nicolaus Ludwn Zinzendorf. Start in your Jerusalem and spread the gospel among nations.

title: : OBEDIENCE TO THE HEA VENL Y VISION
body: : OBEDIENCE TO THE HEA VENL Y VISION

title: : GOD’S EXTRAORDINAR Y DREAM FOR THE CHURCH
body: : GOD’S EXTRAORDINAR Y DREAM FOR THE CHURCH “Unto the church of God which is at Corinth. called to be saints.” (KJV) 1 Cor 1:2 With a straight forward talk, C. S. Lewis said, “The Church exists for nothing else but to draw men into Christ, to make them little Christs. If they are not doing that, all the cathedrals, clergy, missions, sermons, even the Bible itself, are simply a waste of time. God became Man for no other purpose.” God’s extraordinary dream is in His extraordinary goal for the Church - that the Church might be pure and made ready for Christ’s return. He’s coming back - His coming would be sudden - like a thief at night. “And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be” (KJV) Rev 22:12. The church can’t afford to be careless - Matt 24:42-44. Every member of the body must live out God’s extraordinary dream of purity - every where, every time and in every occasion. “For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication” (KJV) 1 Thes 4:3.
confession: His extraordinary dream is my extraordinary dream - living to please Him - everywhere, every time and in every occasion. This is what I will daily pursue by His power. “And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man.” (KJV) Matt 17:9 It was a matter of necessity that the vision which could certainly bring about the opposition and strife of the Jewish rulers should be kept secret, till Jesus had accomplished vision and prophecy. Gen 37:5, 8, 10-11 says,“Now Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers they only hated him the more. His brothers said to him, "Are you indeed to reign over us? Or are you indeed to have dominion over us?" So they hated him yet more for his dreams and for his words. You have a great responsibility to protect - safeguard and carefully nurture - your dreams so as to secure your place in destiny. You have to, by the leading of the Spirit of God, learn who to, when to, how to and where to share some of the sensitive visions of your heart.

title: : TELL THE VISION TO NO MAN
body: : TELL THE VISION TO NO MAN

title: : GOING BEYOND THE EDGE
body: : GOING BEYOND THE EDGE “. as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of the LORD. shall rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan shall be cut off.” (NKJV) Jos 3:13 There are no limits to what man can achieve. The man is the only limit to his lift. If you can dream it, you can dare it. You must go beyond the edge of every river and stand out. Jos 3:15, 17 goes: “And as those who bore the ark came to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark dipped in the edge of the water. and all Israel crossed over on dry ground.” (NKJV). Steps of faith are steps of triumph. The secret of getting ahead is just in getting started and keep the going on the go in spite of obstacles. And if you desire to get 100% in life, don’t give it a 50% energy. If you are going to achieve a task then give it all you’ve got. Always, go a little bit farther than anyone expected you to! When you give that extra little effort in all you do, everyone around you will notice it and they will stand in ovation to celebrate you. Always give your best to your world in every thing you do.
prayer: Father, I ask for the needed strength and doggedness that will not relent until I get to Your ordained place in destiny in Jesus’ name, Amen. “Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you. they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD” (KJV) Jer 23:16 Wolves don't often attack wolves - they go after sheep - both to deceive and ultimately destroy. False prophets come in sheep’s clothing but lo, they are ravenous - coveteous and voracious - wolves. They speak and use the Scriptures as their basis, but their words - looking closely - contradict the Word. “For false Christs shall arise, and false prophets, and will do wonderful miracles so that if it were possible, even God's chosen ones would be deceived. See, I have warned you” (TLB) Matt 24:24-25. These so called prophets are greeddriven rather than grace-driven. They’re sneaky - tricky and cunning - they are not of God. They’re of the devil. It’s needful for all to daily study God’s Word. When you know the truth, lies become clear to you. “And you will have knowledge of what is true, and that will make you free” (BBE) John 8:32. “Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers.” (KJV) Acts 20:28-29.

title: : BEW ARE OF F ALSE PROPHETS
body: : BEW ARE OF F ALSE PROPHETS

title: : INVEST IN PEOPLE
body: : INVEST IN PEOPLE “And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,).” (KJV) Acts 4:36 People need you and so, you need people. Life, by design, is about people. 1 Thes 2:7-8 says, “But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us” (KJV). In investing in people, you must come to terms with what true empathy means. People don’t care how much you know until they know how much you care. Be a people-investor! Labour and travail - night and day. “For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God” (KJV) 1 Thes 2:9. Be a model! Be a standard! Be an example! Exhort and comfort - with one goal - to bringing the people to growth and maturity -1 Thes 2:10-11.
prayer: Thank You Jesus, for this teaching. I pray for grace to demonstrate a life of grace in raising and building numerous lives around me, Amen. “Teach us to number our days and recognize how few they are; help us to spend them as we should” (TLB) Ps 90:12 Time is life - and its use ultimately determines our making - whether we’ll be better or bitter. If we must make the most of life, then we must give adequate attention to those small but significant things we do every day. Create a list of what you would like to achieve - each day to make the most of life. Do your best to overcome your limitations. To some, it’s fear of the unknown; to some, it’s self doubt while some live in the fear of failure. You’ve to overcome all these to truly make the most of life, Pro 6:4-8. Here are some biblical steps to making the most of life: Make a significant change in your sleeping habits. Learn to sleep on time and rise early. Moses was certainly an early riser [Exo 8:20;9:13]. And so was Jesus [Mk 1:35]. And both made the most of life. Pursue your divine assignments one day at a time. You don't conquer the whole world in a day - just be a passionate pursuer. Make the most of each hour and day and you’ll make the most of life.

title: : BE SENSITIVE!
body: : BE SENSITIVE! “. forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia. they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not” (KJV) Acts 16:6-7 Did the Bible say they were forbidden of the Holy Spirit not to preach in Asia. Yes, they were prohibited! There is such as divine interruption where God would not permit you for some assignments even when they’re legitimate. “If we live by the [Holy] Spirit, let us also walk by the Spirit. [If by the Holy Spirit a we have our life in God, let us go forward b walking in line, our conduct controlled by the Spirit.]” (Amp) Gal 5:25. Divine Interruption is a major theme of the Bible. God interrupts! God stepped out of eternity into time to interrupt Moses’ plans [Exo 3:4-8; Heb 3:1]. Elisha was divinely interrupted [1Kings 19:19-20]. David was disallowed from building for God. What about the divine interruption of Peter and Andrew, James and John? “But the Comforter. shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance.” (KJV) John 14:26.
prayer: Father, in whom is the fullness of light and life, enlighten my heart by Your Spirit - so as to understand Your will per time. Give me the grace to receive Your instructions with reverence, Amen. “The weapons we use are not human ones. Our weapons have power from God and can destroy the enemy's strong places.” (ERV) 2 Cor 10:4-5 Satan is constantly at work and so, he is constantly at war. The battle ground is the mind - as he sends his arrows of fear, unbelief and evil thought - so as to set a limit over your life and destiny. Bring every thought to Christ’s obedience by the Word. The Word wins and wins every invisible battle against the enemy. “The tools of our trade aren't for marketing or manipulation, Be prepared. Take all the help you can get, every weapon God has issued, so that when it's all over but the shouting you'll still be on your feet” (TBCL). You’re supernaturally empowered. By God’s order, you’re made to be in control and not the devil. Take your rightful place, refute arguments and theories and reasonings and every proud and lofty thing that sets itself up against your life. Your weapons of warfare are mighty - Eph 6:13.

title: : HE SEES EVER YWHERE
body: : HE SEES EVER YWHERE “Can a man hide himself in secret places so that I cannot see him?” (ESV) Jere 23:24 God knows and sees - everything, every where, every time - at every split second. “Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence? If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there. If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea; Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me. If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me. Yea. the darkness and the light are both alike to thee” (KJV) Ps 139:7-12. God’s eyes run everywhere [Job 24:23; Pro 15:3; Heb 4:13]. He searches all hearts and observes everyone’s ways [1 Kings 8:39; Jer 17:10; Lk 16:15; Rom 8:27]. He knows everything about everything and everybody at the same time. He knows the end right from the beginning - He is all Knowing, all Seeing and ever present everywhere. [1 Sam 23:9-13; Ps 81:14-15]. Bible writers stand in awe of the capacity of God’s mind [Ps 139:1-6; Isa 40:13-14, 28].
prayer: Jesus, I pledge my allegiance, I’ll walk with You humbly all the days of my life, Amen. And she vowed a vow, and said, O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life.” (KJV) 1 Sam 1:11. The highest and noblest assignment on earth is that of a mother. Motherhood, you must understand, is a unique calling. It’s not something you do if there is time, it’s what you have to create time for. “There is no role in life more essential and more eternal than that of motherhood” said M. Russell Ballard. Something is unique about the life of Hannah that worth emulating. “For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him: Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD. And he worshipped the LORD there” (KJV) 1 sam 1:27-28. Hannah was a woman of prayer and worshiper. Dallin H. Oaks said, “The ultimate treasures on earth and in heaven are our children and our posterity.”

title: : IN HIM YOU HA VE LIFE
verse: In him was life; and the life was the light of men”
body: : IN HIM YOU HA VE LIFE In him was life; and the life was the light of men” (KJV) John 1:4 God hath given us eternal life - a right to endless glory. And this life is in His Son; it comes from and through Him. “He who believes in the Son of God [who adheres to, trusts in, and relies on Him] has the testimony [possesses this divine attestation] within himself. He who does not believe God [in this way] has made Him out to be and represented Him as a liar.” 1 John 5:10-12. “He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him” (KJV) John 3:36. Jesus has the supreme power - His power is absolute, total, ultimate and matchless. By the reason of your encounter with Him, sicknesses, attacks and evils that lord it over the people of the world are not permitted to lord it over you.
confession: “But to as many as did receive and welcome Him, He gave the authority (power, privilege, right) to become the children of God, that is, to those who believe in (adhere to, trust in, and rely on) His name.” Because I receive and welcome Him, I have the right of power in Christ Jesus. [Sing the Hymn: Jesus Loves Even Me] “. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world” (KJV) John 16:33 You can be joyful - in good spirit - even in the midst of life challenges. Elder Richard G. Scott said, “Sadness, disappointment, and severe challenges are events in life, not life itself. They should not be allowed to become the confining center of everything you do.” There are three instances where Jesus said, “Be of good cheer.” At the sight of the sick of the palsy, Matt 9:2. When the wind was contrary to the disciples, Mark 6:50. The third was in connection towards His departure, John 16:33. Charles Albert Tindley sang, When the storms of life are raging, Stand by me (stand by me); When the storms of life are raging, Stand by me (stand by me); When the world is tossing me, Like a ship upon the sea, Thou Who rulest wind and water, Stand by me (stand by me). In the midst of tribulation, Stand by me (stand by me); In the midst of tribulation, Stand by me (stand by me); When the hosts of hell assail, And my strength begins to fail, Thou Who never lost a battle, Stand by me (stand by me).
